work_completed: Reviewed nlt-pi and the related asfdk-harness, asfdk, and nlt-coding-agent repositories.
Established that asfdk-harness is not published to npm and that the MVP imported a non-existent package name, so the MVP could not typecheck on main.
Vendored the required subset of asfdk-harness src (commit f28136d) into mvp/src/harness/ with provenance headers and README.
Declared @neurolift-technologies/asfdk and typebox, pinned the workspace coding-agent dependency, and fixed MVP tsconfig for TypeScript 7.
Found and fixed a dead crisis gate: it compared runtime level values to enum member names and read risk flags at the wrong depth; it now blocks and fails closed. Moved to mvp/src/gate.ts.
Added 16 vitest tests (gate unit tests, end-to-end governedTurn against the real foundation, endpoint handler tests); a mutation check confirmed the tests catch the old behavior.
Added a preview-only POST /api/govern endpoint that returns only the gate decision and returns 404 in production.
Opened draft PR #15 and pushed a Vercel preview deployment (READY).

decisions_made: Follow the owner's direction: no package publish; build the harness into nlt-pi from source.
Vendor only the needed closure (not the MCP server, hub, A2A proxy, Cloudflare pipeline, plugins).
Keep the default prompt channel as UNKNOWN: measurement showed channel did not change gate outcomes, and trusting input is an authority decision.
Make the Vercel test endpoint preview-only (404 in production) with executionEnabled false.
